result.title: TRUST-Stereo: Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching
result.summary: Coarse-to-fine stereo matching enables efficient disparity estimation but remains sensitive to errors in propagated disparity, which may place ground-truth correspondences outside subsequent local search ranges. We propose TRUST-Stereo (Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching), which addresses this limitation through an Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM). UGRSM estimates the reliability of propagated disparity and predicts residual offsets to adaptively relocate local cost-volume centers. Additionally, we introduce a two-stage Senior-Junior Teacher Assistant knowledge distillation strategy to transfer rich monocular representations from a large foundation model to a lightweight backbone to achieve fast stereo matching performance. Experiments on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization. Using only 1.4M synthetic stereo pairs, TRUST-Stereo achieves state-of-the-art results on several benchmark metrics, outperforming competing efficient methods trained with substantially larger datasets, including real-world pseudo-labeled samples. Specifically, it achieves a KITTI 2015 EPE of 0.93, ETH3D Bad 1.0 of 2.13% and Middlebury Bad 2.0 of 6.79% while maintaining inference at approximately 50 ms per stereo pair.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TRUST-Stereo 快速立体匹配方法：用不确定性引导残差搜索模块（UGRSM）估计传播视差的可靠性并预测残差偏移以重定位局部代价体中心，另用两级师生蒸馏把大基础模型的单目表示迁移到轻量骨干，在多个基准上取得较强零样本泛化与约 50 ms 推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先评估传播状态可靠性、再预测修正量以重定位局部搜索范围」的粗到细迭代机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态误差累积的纠正与视觉证据的局部重筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但立体匹配任务与多模态推理相距较远，迁移价值需人工判断。
